mapper.select: SELECT emp01_emp_no AS emp_no , f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, f_today()::date, 'pos_nm') AS pos_name , f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, f_today()::date, 'title_nm') AS title_name , emp01_mobile_telno AS mobile_telno FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_person_id = #{personId}

SELECT emp20_leave_cd AS leave_code , f_cdnm('leaveCode', emp20_leave_cd, emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS leave_name , emp20_start_date AS start_date , emp20_close_date AS close_date , emp20_leave_count AS leave_count , CASE WHEN emp20_leave_cd = '05' THEN (SELECT emp22_reason FROM emp22_etc_leave WHERE emp22_etc_leave_id = emp20_etc_leave_id) ELSE f_cdnm('SpecialLeaveCode', emp20_spc_leave_cd, emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) END AS spc_leave_name , emp20_reason AS reason , ( SELECT emp01_kor_nm ||' '|| f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, emp20_start_date, 'pos_nm') FROM apr07_alt_appr INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = apr07_alt_emp_id WHERE apr07_target_emp_id = emp20_person_id AND emp20_leave_id = apr07_leave_id LIMIT 1 ) AS alt_person_name , emp20_manager_nm AS manager_name , emp20_emergency_telno AS emergency_telno FROM emp20_leave WHERE emp20_leave_id = #{leaveId} AND emp20_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT f_emp_kor_nm(emp54_person_id) AS person_name , f_org_nm(emp03_org_code_id, f_sysdate()) AS org_name , f_cdnm('ErrandCode', emp54_errand_cd, emp54_company_id, emp54_date) AS errand_name , emp54_date AS date , emp54_depart_time AS depart_time , emp54_return_time AS return_time , emp54_reason AS reason , emp54_host AS host , emp54_venue AS venue , emp54_note AS note FROM emp54_errand LEFT OUTER JOIN emp03_trans ON ( emp54_person_id = emp03_person_id AND emp03_trans_cd NOT IN ('800','900') AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans x WHERE x.emp03_person_id = emp54_person_id AND x.emp03_trans_date <= f_sysdate() ) ) WHERE emp54_errand_id = #{errandId} AND emp54_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT att05_work_date::date AS work_date , att05_reason AS reason , policy.att01_pm_work_start_time || ' ~ ' || policy.att01_pm_work_end_time AS time_str , att01_break_minutes AS break_minutes , EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (policy.att01_pm_work_end_time::time - policy.att01_pm_work_start_time::time - (policy.att01_break_minutes * INTERVAL '1 minute')) )::int ||'시간 '|| LPAD(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (policy.att01_pm_work_end_time::time - policy.att01_pm_work_start_time::time - (policy.att01_break_minutes * INTERVAL '1 minute')) )::int::text, 2, '0') || '분' AS work_time_str FROM att05_pm_work LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT att01_pm_work_start_time , att01_pm_work_end_time , att01_break_minutes FROM att01_work_policy WHERE att01_company_id = att05_company_id AND att01_use_yn = 'true' AND att01_start_date <= att05_work_date ORDER BY att01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) policy ON TRUE WHERE att05_pm_work_id = #{pmWorkId} AND att05_company_id = #{companyId}
